# Cisco

Cover IOS/IOS XE and platform-specific switching/routing/WLAN operations. Confirm exact platform and release before generating commands. Common topics: VLANs, trunks, STP, EtherChannel/LACP, SVIs, routing, ACLs, DHCP relay, PoE, port security, logging, SNMP, configuration archive, and software lifecycle. Treat command syntax and feature support as release-specific.
